about: The help assistant's exam paper (AI plan, section 10.1). Each question lists the guide sections a correct answer comes from; 'none' means the assistant must not answer from the guide (out of scope). Add every thumbs-down question here after fixing it. English, Bangla and Banglish on purpose.
